info.title: OpenStreetlifting API
info.description:
OpenStreetlifting is an open, collaborative project building a permanent and traceable archive of all Streetlifting data, freely accessible to everyone.

This is the public API to read that archive.

get.description: Returns athletes sorted by last name.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Results per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

get.description: Returns the best results by movement, gender and weight class. Ties go to the earlier result.

parameters.name: weight_class
parameters.description:
A weight class such as `M-73` or `F+70`, or `open` for the best across all classes.
With a federation or series, any class it entered athletes in, such as `M-75`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as `FR`.

parameters.name: federation
parameters.description: A federation name, as listed by `/api/v1/records/facets`.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: A competition series, as listed by `/api/v1/records/facets`.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Only lifts from competitions held in this year.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Entries per group, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 3.

200.description: The best results in the OpenStreetlifting archive, grouped by movement, gender and weight class. The open group comes first in each gender.

GenderConstants.description:
Benchmark constants.

RIS is `total * 100 / benchmark`, where
`benchmark = a + (k - a) / (1 + q * exp(-b * (bodyweight - v)))`.

custom_weight_classes.description:
True when the selected federation or series entered athletes in weight classes outside
the standard ladder. Records are then grouped by the classes it used.

weight_class.description:
The weight class, or `null` for the open record. A standard class unless a federation
or series is selected, which lists the classes it used.

RecordMark.description:
Current best in the archive for a weight class: `WR` worldwide, `NR` nationally. Not ratified by
a federation.

RisPerformanceResponse.description: A result scored with the RIS formula.

RisSource.description:
Where a RIS score came from. `computed` was worked out from the athlete's
bodyweight and total. `reported` preserves the published score when either
input is missing.
